name: draconic-gaze
description: D&D campaign management app for remote play
author: Draconic Gaze

scripts.start: npm run build && npx tsx server/src/index.ts --static
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:rebuild && npm run electron:compile && concurrently "cd client && npx vite" "sleep 3 && npx electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:rebuild && npm run electron:build-client && npm run electron:compile && npx electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:pack: npm run electron:rebuild && npm run electron:build-client && npm run electron:compile && npx electron-builder --dir
